notes:
- Deleting many playlists at once now works for any number: the selected playlists are deleted in batches, with progress shown and a combined report at the end. Before, only the first ~200 of a large selection were deleted.
- Configuration pages now handle large forms correctly. Any form over 8 KB used to arrive damaged, which also cut a large playlist selection short. An upload that is cut off no longer ties up the server.
